The alteration check returned no change for NVDA and AMZN, the only book tickers in the claims. Rule 4 now allows `spawn_new_thesis`, which handles one company per call. NVDA carries the most claims: a higher-current power shelf redesign for the next platform, a slip in first volume shipments into Q1, and requalification of two other power suppliers. None of the NVDA pillars addresses power-supply timing. NVDA.p2 covers packaging and HBM, not power components. I'll check NVDA first. An AMZN call may follow, since the custom-silicon rack order surge is also unmentioned by any AMZN pillar.

_call: spawn_new_thesis for NVDA with its claims.
